title: Quarter cadence playbook: capacity-aware OKR lanes for Hosted API & Model Catalog
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Objective: Produce a repeatable quarterly playbook that aligns Hosted API and Model Catalog roadmap lanes to capacity forecasts, OKRs, and contingency (hedge) plans for demand surges.

Background: As usage patterns diversify across customers and regions, model lineup decisions and Hosted API capacity commits increasingly drive both cost and reliability. PM and Eng need a lightweight, operationalized planning loop to translate OKRs and capacity signals into prioritized roadmap lanes (growth, stability, experiment) with clear rollback and canary windows.

Goals:
- Define three roadmap lanes (Core Stability, Growth Experiments, Capacity Hedge) for Hosted API + Model Catalog that map to OKRs and target SLOs.
- Create lightweight capacity triggers (traffic thresholds, latency envelopes, token cost bands) that automatically shift priority between lanes during the quarter.
- Produce a handoff template for engineering and design with clear acceptance criteria, rollout windows, and observability signposts.
- Deliver one cross-functional simulation (seasonal surge) that validates hedging logic and rollback procedures.

Success metrics:
- Playbook adopted by at least two product squads for Q2 planning.
- One simulated surge exercise completed with documented runbook and <24h follow-up action list.
- Reduction in mid-quarter unplanned capacity escalations by 30% vs prior quarter.

Approach:
1) Synthesize historical usage, cost-per-token, latency tail metrics and model health signals to define lane thresholds.
2) Run a cross-functional workshop (PM/Eng/Infra/Console) to map OKRs to lanes and to identify critical paths (e.g., dedicated capacity vs hosted fallback).
3) Draft templates: roadmap lane brief, rollout checklist, canary windows + rollback criteria, observability dashboard spec.
4) Ship playbook draft; pilot with one Hosted API product squad and one model onboarding stream.
5) Run surge simulation and collect learning artifacts into Confluence.

Stakeholders: PM (owner), Runtime Eng, Capacity/Infra, DevEx (Console), Design, Sales/CS for customer signal input.

Deliverables:
- Playbook doc (Confluence link in comments)
- Roadmap lane templates (editable)
- Canary & rollback checklist
- Surge simulation report and action backlog

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: metrics not aligned across teams -> Mitigation: single source-of-truth dashboard + weekly sync during planning cycle.
- Risk: over-committing dedicated capacity that increases cost -> Mitigation: include cost guardrails and a fallthrough to compatible quantized model variants.
- Risk: insufficient observability for canary decisions -> Mitigation: require baseline dashboards before pilot sign-off.

Acceptance criteria:
- Playbook doc approved by Eng lead and two PMs.
- Pilot squad completes at least one canary rollout under playbook rules.
- Surge simulation run, report published, and top-5 action items triaged into backlog.

Notes: This ticket is deliberately scoped to produce the operational playbook and pilot; separate follow-ups will implement automation for threshold detection and auto-routing policies.
